messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: PD-5121 - latency.p99 > 2000ms for 5m (SLO burn 28%)
ryan (oncall): acked in PD, I'm on it. tagging @maya for SRE assist.
maya (sre): on call, looking at traces now. initial guess: tokenization queue backing up on eu-west pods.
luke (infra): checking autoscaler and instance health, any preemptions?
ryan (oncall): no recent deploys from me. I see a small spike in concurrent requests for the embeddings route.
maya (sre): traces show tail latency concentrated on model-side GPU queue; KV cache hit rate dropped ~40%. suspect cache thrash from a bad key pattern.
zoe (eng-ops): adding traffic diversion rule to route low-priority customers to fallback model (quantized variant) to reduce pressure. applying now.
pagerduty-bot: Note: escalation to SRE lead in 12m if not resolved.
maya (sre): applied temporary KV cache pinning on hot prefixes (runbook: kvcache/mitigate-hotkeys). monitoring.
luke (infra): scaled dedicated pool +2 nodes in eu-west to give headroom; autoscaler shows activity.
ryan (oncall): can you post the command you ran?
maya (sre): ran: `kubectl exec -n redwood kvcache-ctrl -- curl -X POST /admin/evict?prefix=hotkey123` and then `kubectl scale deployment/redwood-serving --replicas=14 -n eu-west`
ryan (oncall): saw p99 drop from ~2.6s -> 1.9s after cache pinning, still above target.
zoe (eng-ops): diversion applied completed; ~18% of traffic now on fallback model. Observed immediate drop in tokens/sec served by the heavy pool.
maya (sre): continuing to watch. creating a short-lived alert to track SLO burn trend.
ryan (oncall): customer-impact check — any user-facing errors?
maya (sre): no 5xx spike, mainly increased latency. product reports some slowness for high-volume customers, no data loss.
zoe (eng-ops): opening a customer bulletin draft for impacted tenants, will hold until we stabilize.
ryan (oncall): if this doesn't stabilize by next 10m, we'll promote fallback model to 30% and start model gating for heavy clients.
pagerduty-bot: Acknowledgement recorded by ryan (oncall). Time to ack: 00:01:12
luke (infra): one of the older GPU hosts shows elevated dmesg preemption logs; marking it for drain.
maya (sre): draining and reprovisioning host; moving pods off.
ryan (oncall): handoff to night oncall in 25m, but we'll keep this open until SLO burn < 10% for 10m.
zoe (eng-ops): update: after diversion bump to 30% fallback, p99 steady at ~1.2s, SLO burn down to 8%.
maya (sre): agree, looks stable. I'll keep an eye for 15m then close the PD alert if it holds.
ryan (oncall): thanks all — add short postmortem note in incidents/ when stable. Also link runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-kv-hotkey
pagerduty-bot: PD-5121 status changed: Resolved by maya (sre) at 1807661385
ryan (oncall): resolving thread here — follow-up tasks: (1) postmortem + traffic pattern analysis, (2) permanent hotkey mitigation (rate-limit or sharding), (3) improve autoscaler headroom heuristics.
maya (sre): noted. I'll own the postmortem.
zoe (eng-ops): will draft customer bulletin.
ryan (oncall): thanks team :thumbsup:
